_comment: Curation for projects.json, the README, and www.thedubes.com. The most active repos (top_count of them, by commits in the last 30 days) become highlight tiles at the top; other featured repos follow, in this order; every other public, non-fork repo is listed automatically under 'Everything else'. Taglines and images are optional - the repo description is used when tagline is missing.

featured.title: claudeMon
featured.why: A btop-style task manager for Claude Code: watch token burn, forecast limits, and see subagents and prompt-cache hits live in the terminal.
featured.tagline: Terminal task manager for Claude Code: token burn, limits forecast, subagents and prompt cache. Python stdlib only.

featured.title: MacBridge
featured.why: Calendar and Reminders for Claude Code and Claude Desktop. A menu-bar app and MCP server that runs entirely on your Mac, with no network.
featured.tagline: Free, open-source menu-bar app and MCP server giving Claude Code and Claude Desktop read and write access to Calendar and Reminders through EventKit.

featured.title: Paratroopers: Air Assault
featured.why: A 2010 iPhone classic that no longer runs on any current iPhone, rebuilt from scratch in Swift for today's iPhones and iPads. The progress log updates on every check-in.
featured.tagline: A labour-of-love Swift rebuild of the 2010 iPhone game Paratroopers: Air Assault for modern iPhone and iPad. Progress log and showcase.

featured.title: RetroSVR
featured.tagline: Windows screensaver of classic 8-bit demoscene effects: starfields, plasma and scrollers in chunky 4x pixels.

featured.title: Wlprz
featured.why: Live wallpapers for macOS: videos, images and interactive GPU shader scenes, per display, with playlists, schedules and battery-aware playback.
featured.tagline: Live wallpapers for macOS: video, images and GPU shader scenes on every display, from the menu bar.

featured.title: C64 spritemove
featured.why: Raster-bar overture, then up to 16 rolling Boing balls with real elastic collisions, flying through the open border. A raster IRQ multiplexes them over the VIC-II's eight sprites.
featured.tagline: A Commodore 64 demo in 6502 assembly: raster bars, then up to 16 bouncing balls multiplexed through the VIC-II's eight hardware sprites.

featured.title: SpaceRunner
featured.why: A full endless runner for iOS 26, built from scratch with SpriteKit.
featured.tagline: Fast-paced endless runner in space, built with SpriteKit for iOS 26.

featured.title: Vibe Stats for macOS
featured.why: One vendor's bad day shouldn't look like your tools being down. Per-component health for Claude, Copilot, OpenAI and Gemini, in the menu bar.
featured.tagline: Menu bar app that tracks Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI and Gemini health per component, so one vendor's bad day doesn't look like an outage of the tool you use.

featured.title: wthrr
featured.why: Snow, rain, storms, fog and aurora across every display, driven by live weather. v1.1 added Clear Skies mode and runs 2x faster.
featured.tagline: Animated weather on your macOS desktop: snow, rain, storms, fog and aurora across every display, driven by live weather and controlled from the menu bar.

featured.title: C64 Agent Kit
featured.why: Agent Skills for Commodore 64 6502 assembly: KickAssembler, VICE and Regenerator 2000, for Claude Code and friends.
featured.tagline: Agent Skills for Commodore 64 6502 assembly: KickAssembler, VICE, Regenerator 2000. Works in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and Gemini CLI.

featured.title: ReviewAppPerms
featured.tagline: Inspect, audit and revoke macOS privacy permissions. Reads both TCC databases and shows which apps can use your camera, microphone, files and screen.

featured.title: Lunar Lander
featured.tagline: The classic lander in C++17 for Windows and macOS: gravity, thrust and a fuel gauge between you and the surface.

featured.title: Vibe Stats
featured.tagline: Browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Safari showing component-level status for the AI dev tools you rely on.
